content: LINE webhook signature: base64_encode(hash_hmac('sha256', rawBody, channelSecret, true)) compared to x-line-signature header using constant-time compare (hash_equals in PHP). Must verify against the exact raw, unparsed request body - any reformatting/JSON re-encoding before verification breaks it. No reliance on source IP; the HMAC is the only trust boundary. Matches SPEC.md 7 exactly.
